message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18 1815, resulted in heavy losses on both sides. Roughly:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~23 000 |
| French | ~25 000 |
| **Total** | ~48 000 |

These figures include killed, wounded, and missing soldiers. The exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places total casualties at around 48 000.
